name: PagerDuty
label: PagerDuty REST API v2
description: PagerDuty REST API v2 via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://developer.pagerduty.com/api-reference/. Operations: incident_create, incident_get, incident_list, incident_update, note_create, note_list, log_get, user_get, oncall_get, listen. REST v2 sends Accept: application/vnd.pagerduty+json;version=2 via extraHeaders. Auth secret api_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: incident_create | incident_get | incident_list | incident_update | note_create | note_list | log_get | user_get | oncall_get | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'incident_create'.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Incident or user id.

schema.label: incident
schema.description: Incident envelope escape hatch for incident_create/update. Purpose fields title/type/service_id/urgency/status merge into incident via bodyMap. Example: {"escalation_policy":{"id":"PT20YPA","type":"escalation_policy_reference"}}.

schema.label: from_email
schema.description: PagerDuty From header (login email of a valid user). Required by incident_create, incident_update, note_create. Example: oncall@example.com.

schema.label: urgencies[]
schema.description: incident_list filter. high,low.

schema.label: since
schema.description: incident_list ISO 8601 start.

schema.label: until
schema.description: incident_list ISO 8601 end.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Query-string parameter `limit` for operation: incident_list.

schema.label: offset
schema.description: Query-string parameter `offset` for operation: incident_list.

schema.label: statuses[]
schema.description: Query-string parameter `statuses[]` for operation: incident_list.

schema.label: service_ids[]
schema.description: Query-string parameter `service_ids[]` for operation: incident_list.

schema.label: note
schema.description: Note envelope escape hatch for note_create. Purpose field content merges as note.content. Example: {"content":"Checked the disk."}.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Incident type on incident_create/update. Nested as incident.type. EXACT create: incident. EXACT update: incident_reference. Example: incident.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Incident title on incident_create (required by PagerDuty) and incident_update. Nested as incident.title. Example: The server is on fire.

schema.label: service_id
schema.description: Service id on incident_create. Nested as incident.service.id. Pair with service_type=service_reference. Example: PWIXJZS.

schema.label: service_type
schema.description: Service reference type on incident_create. Nested as incident.service.type. EXACT: service_reference. Example: service_reference.

schema.label: urgency
schema.description: Incident urgency on create/update. Nested as incident.urgency. EXACT: high | low. Example: high.

schema.label: incident_key
schema.description: Dedupe key on incident_create. Nested as incident.incident_key. Example: disk-full-host-1.

schema.label: details
schema.description: Incident body details on incident_create. Nested as incident.body.details. Example: Disk 92% full on host-1.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Incident status on incident_update. Nested as incident.status. EXACT: acknowledged | resolved. Example: acknowledged.

schema.label: resolution
schema.description: Resolution text on incident_update when status=resolved. Nested as incident.resolution. Example: Rolled back deploy.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Note body on note_create. Nested as note.content. Example: Checked the disk.

schema.label: schedule_ids[]
schema.description: Query-string parameter `schedule_ids[]` for operation: oncall_get.

schema.label: user_ids[]
schema.description: incident_list assignee filter.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP Status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: incident_create, incident_get, incident_list, incident_update, note_create, note_list, log_get, user_get, oncall_get, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: PagerDuty REST API key. Authorization: Token token=<key>. REST v2 Accept: application/vnd.pagerduty+json;version=2 is sent via extraHeaders (https://developer.pagerduty.com/api-reference/). Include requester in body when the API requires From.

configurationParameters.label: From email
configurationParameters.description: Default From header for write ops (PagerDuty user email). INPUT from_email wins.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
